description.invocation: Per rank of a 2-rank NCCL DDP job, execute one complete accumulated GPT-2 training step with the same semantics as step() in gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105: optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True), then 4 microbatch forward/backward passes over that rank's pre-generated token inputs (shape (micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128), values torch.randint(0, 50257) from a per-rank generator seeded 31000+rank, consumed in order), each computing GPT2LMHeadModel(input_ids=tokens, labels=tokens, use_cache=False).loss / 4 then loss.backward(), with gradient synchronization such that after the 4th microbatch every parameter holds the full global-batch gradient (baseline: DDP no_sync() on the first 3 microbatches, gpt2_ddp_training.py:40); then optimizer.step() (SGD lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False). Completion boundary: torch.cuda.synchronize() on every rank after optimizer.step(). The 4-microbatch accumulation is genuine internal iteration of the step and stays inside one invocation; effective batch = 2 ranks x 1 micro_batch x 4 accumulation_steps = 8 (1024 tokens per step). State semantics: every measured invocation starts from the identical seeded initial state (torch.manual_seed(20261020) initialization captured before measurement); weight reset (raw_model.load_state_dict(initial)) is setup outside the measured work, and no other state may carry between invocations. Required numerics: FP32 model and compute with TF32 disabled (torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, float32_matmul_precision='highest'), dropout 0 (resid_pdrop=embd_pdrop=attn_pdrop=0.0), use_cache=False, attn_implementation='eager'. Source-required correctness, verified outside the timed invocation: the post-accumulation gradient must match a serial single-GPU reference that processes the exact same global batch (rank 0's 4 microbatches then rank 1's) without DDP, within grad_atol=1e-6 / grad_rtol=1e-4; gradients must be exactly equal across ranks (atol=0.0, rtol=0.0); post-step parameters must match the reference within parameter_atol=1e-6 / parameter_rtol=1e-4; the accumulated loss must be finite; and the tolerance check must reject a +1 corrupted gradient (negative control). The baseline DDP mechanics (no_sync accumulation, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True, broadcast_buffers=False) are baseline implementation choices, not frozen requirements: semantics-equivalent synchronization/communication strategies are the purpose of this objective, provided the gradient, parameter, state and tolerance semantics above still hold.
